C0814.title: Former Employee Sentenced to 16 Months for Malicious Data Deletion
C0814.summary: In October 2020, Luo joined a tech company for platform data maintenance. Upon resignation and dissatisfied with his compensation, he used his retained account credentials to deliberately delete critical data from the company's cloud server backend, causing the company to pay 120,000 yuan in compensation to a partner.
